Apply for a fixture benefit

This portal helps residents check eligibility and apply for a monthly support benefit.

Eligibility

You can apply if you are a resident of the fixture district and are eighteen years or older.

Documents required

Keep an identity document and a proof of address ready before you start.

Fees

The application is free of cost.

How to apply

Fill the online form, upload the documents and submit. You will receive a reference number.

Need help?

Call the helpline from nine to five on working days.
